grid-columns-and-rows.label: Grid Columns and Rows
grid-columns-and-rows.summary: Create two-dimensional layouts with explicit grid columns and rows.

sketch0.title: Grid organizes rows and columns together

sketch2.title: Rows can size themselves from content

try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch0.title: Try it yourself: Turn the inherited main region into a Grid container
try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch0.prompt:
Now apply what you just learned in this task. ## CSS task

Flexbox has produced a useful wrapping layout, but the main content now needs explicit two-dimensional track control. Grid changes the layout model at the existing parent so rows and columns can be designed together without changing the HTML. Continue from the exact Module 3 checkpoint. Add `main { display: grid; }` to `styles.css`. Keep all inherited HTML and earlier CSS. Preview the page: the content should remain intact, with main now ready for explicit Grid tracks.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on. Produce the result for turn the inherited main region into a Grid container so it reinforces Grid Columns and Rows.

try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch1.title: Try it yourself: Give the Grid two equal columns
try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch1.prompt:
Now apply what you just learned in this task. ## CSS task

Main is a Grid container, but auto-placement still lacks a deliberate column structure. Two equal fractional tracks divide the available `width` evenly while remaining fluid. Continue the cumulative stylesheet. Append a `main` rule with `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;`. Check a page with multiple main children: they should begin arranging into two equal columns when the available space permits.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on. Produce the result for give the Grid two equal columns so it reinforces Grid Columns and Rows.

try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch2.title: Try it yourself: Let the explicit row size itself from content
try_grid_columns_and_rows_sketch2.prompt:
Now apply what you just learned in this task. ## CSS task

The columns are defined, but the explicit row should follow its content instead of being forced to an arbitrary `height`. An automatic row size keeps the Grid responsive to whatever content each page contains. Continue the cumulative stylesheet. Append `main { grid-template-rows: auto; }`. Preview pages with different amounts of content: the row should size naturally without clipping or unnecessary fixed space.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on. Produce the result for let the explicit row size itself from content so it reinforces Grid Columns and Rows.
